title: Photo Booth Hire Surrey | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Surrey for weddings, proms and corporate events from Guildford to Weybridge. Attendant and setup included from £299. Get a free quote.
intro: Boothdrop Entertainment delivers photo booth hire throughout Surrey, from the Thames towns of Staines, Egham and Weybridge down through Guildford and the Surrey Hills to Farnham and Dorking. Packages from £299 include a professional attendant, delivery and setup, unlimited sessions during the hire and a personalised print template, with an £80 deposit to secure the date.

sections.heading: What Surrey events look like, and how we plan for them
paragraphs: Surrey weddings are often held in country houses and barns in the Surrey Hills, with the booth placed in the reception room or an adjoining space where it can run from after the speeches until the end of the evening. A guest book comes with every print booth, and the attendant collects a copy of each print alongside a message. Because many of these venues are a drive from the nearest town, we build in generous travel time and arrive well before the hire window.

Golf clubs across the county, from Camberley to Epsom, host Christmas parties, charity dinners and milestone birthdays. School proms in Guildford, Woking, Reigate and Redhill keep us busy in early summer, while corporate clients in Weybridge, Leatherhead and Staines book branded booths for awards nights and summer socials. For every event type we supply a custom print design with your names or logo, and digital copies are shared by email or QR code on the night.

sections.heading: The towns and roads behind our Surrey coverage
paragraphs: Guildford and Woking sit at the centre of our Surrey work, with Godalming and Farnham to the south-west and Dorking, Leatherhead, Epsom, Reigate and Redhill along the North Downs. The Thames-side towns of Staines, Chertsey, Egham, Weybridge, Walton-on-Thames and Esher form the northern band closest to London, and Camberley covers the western edge towards Hampshire.

The M25 loops around the top of the county and links to the A3 for Guildford and Godalming, the M3 for Camberley and Chertsey, and the A24 for Leatherhead and Dorking. Travel is planned into every booking, and delivery and setup come as part of the package rather than as an extra charge.

sections.heading: Country houses, golf clubs and village halls
paragraphs: The Surrey Hills are home to converted barns, country houses and estate venues with gardens that lend themselves to summer marquees. Golf clubs are more plentiful here than almost anywhere else in the south-east, and their function suites are well suited to a booth with a two-metre footprint. Along the Thames at Weybridge, Egham and Staines there are riverside hotels and restaurants with private dining rooms.

School halls, village halls and community centres host proms, birthdays and anniversary parties, and the booths work just as well in a parquet-floored hall as in a ballroom. For corporate events, hotels and conference venues near Woking, Weybridge and Leatherhead are the usual choice.

sections.heading: Access and power: what we check before the day
paragraphs: Surrey Hills venues can involve narrow lanes, steep approaches and long gravel drives, so we confirm the route and the unloading point with the venue and allow extra time to get the equipment inside on trolleys. Country houses sometimes place the function room up a flight of stairs; that is fine with notice, and a lift is helpful where one exists. Golf clubs and hotels usually have straightforward ground-floor access and a car park close to the entrance.

We need about 45 to 60 minutes to set up before the hire window opens, and that time is not charged as hire time. Every booth apart from the Inflatable Booth runs from a single standard socket. For marquee weddings on a lawn, a reliable 13A supply is a must, and if a generator is involved we ask the marquee company to confirm it will carry the booth alongside the lighting and catering load.

sections.heading: Popular booths for Surrey venues
paragraphs: The Magic Mirror is the leading choice for Surrey country house weddings; its full-length mirror, animations and prints for every guest fit the polished style of these venues. The LCD SlimPod is the go-to for golf club parties, proms and village hall celebrations, where its 1.5-metre by 2-metre footprint, two prints per session and background removal give excellent value from £299.

Corporate planners around Woking, Weybridge and Staines increasingly choose the GIF Booth for a digital-first experience with animated overlays and instant email or QR delivery, which suits summer socials and product launches where guests want to share straight to social media.

faqs.q: Where do you unload at a golf club or country house?
faqs.a: Golf clubs normally have a car park beside the clubhouse, so we unload at the nearest door and park up for the evening. Country houses may ask suppliers to use a service entrance or a back drive; we follow the venue's instructions and move the vehicle once the equipment is inside.

faqs.q: Can you set up in a marquee in the Surrey Hills?
faqs.a: Yes, marquee weddings on country house lawns are common in Surrey. We need a level, firm floor, cover from the weather and a reliable 13A socket within a few metres. If the marquee runs on a generator, ask the supplier to confirm it will carry the booth alongside lighting and catering.

faqs.q: Do you charge for travel within Surrey?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included in every package, so Surrey bookings almost never carry a travel charge. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so there is no surprise once the booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: Do you allow for M25 traffic when planning your arrival?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan the journey around the time of day and the usual pinch points on the M25, A3 and M3, and build the 45 to 60 minute setup window in on top. If the venue has a strict supplier arrival slot, tell us when booking and we will target it.

faqs.q: Can we hire a booth for a school prom in Surrey?
faqs.a: Of course. The attendant stays with the booth for the whole hire, keeps the queue moving and looks after the props. The print template can carry the school name, year group and date, and digital copies can be shared with students by email or QR code on the night.
